purpose: Predeclare what each candidate propagation/buffering mechanism would have to look like across island cases before new measurements can promote any mechanism into the ABM, while keeping breeding-system indices and realized reproductive performance as distinct response axes.

synthetic_capability_updates.network_context: sign-level service/reproductive rescue replicated in two frozen stochastic blocks, with worsening also present; context-dependent buffering-capable branch allocator
synthetic_capability_updates.autonomous_assurance: magnitude attenuation replicated, but sign-level rescue from the initial v14 block did not replicate in an independent block or broader support envelope

required_signature: direct effective service is low or reduced
reproductive output is maintained relative to an explicit capacity denominator
autonomous reproduction is high in the same matched units
buffering weakens where autonomous reproduction is low after direct service is accounted for
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: repeated whole-reproduction buffering under low service in units with low autonomous reproduction or high direct pollinator dependency

required_signature: pollinator composition or global functional opportunity changes
rate-weighted total effective service is maintained or rescued because alternative partners compensate in rate and/or effectiveness
reproductive output follows the maintained effective-service state
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: whole-reproduction buffering when rate-weighted effective service is clearly reduced and no compensating visitor-specific service channel is measured

current_case_reading.guaiacum: service_mapping_reference_not_buffer_case; visitor assemblage differs strongly but direct per-visit effectiveness is missing

required_signature: an upstream service or interaction-quality deficit is directly measured
autonomous assurance and direct service are measured sufficiently to exclude them as the sole buffer
a resource or demographic process responds to the perturbation in the same units
the measured compensatory process predicts or experimentally restores reproductive performance
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: resource change that is not linked to reproductive maintenance after assurance and direct service are separated

required_signature: island trait or assurance differences exist without a measured current service deficit
independent colonization, establishment, or survivorship history varies across units
the trait or assurance difference tracks the establishment history better than current pollinator shortage
current service and reproductive state are measured rather than inferred from syndrome
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: the same trait shift repeatedly emerges within established native populations in direct response to current service loss

guaiacum_reproductive_axis_decoupling.role: Visitor environment differs strongly; self/outcross seed-set ISI is similar and autogamy negligible, while realized open reproduction is pollen limited on Mona and multiplicative fitness is lower. This constrains service mapping and forces reproductive axes to remain distinct.

decision_rules_for_future_data: A source-supported candidate can remain candidate-only before ABM admission.
Synthetic capability cannot be assigned to a real island without a source-native mapping and frozen held-out/prospective test.
If more than one candidate signature remains compatible, classify the buffer as unresolved rather than fitting all candidates.
If one reproductive axis is stable and another declines, classify axis decoupling rather than whole-reproduction buffering.
If a candidate reaches mapping-ready status, freeze the mapping, parameter derivation and pass/fail target before testing downstream outcome.
If the predeclared test fails, retain the failure and reopen only with genuinely new independent evidence, not retuning on the same target.
current_result: network-context sign-buffering is a replicated synthetic capability but no empirical buffer mechanism is admitted; Hawaiʻi and Nicotiana remain candidate buffer systems, while Guaiacum is reclassified as reproductive-axis decoupling and network-context service-mapping reference
claim_boundary: These are qualitative mechanism-discrimination predictions. They do not assume effect-size commensurability across islands and do not make any candidate universal.
